records.name: Dreiecksleiter Dazwischen
records.biography_en: Keeps three people apart by insisting he is the only thing joining them. His triangular HyperNorm frame gives every disagreement a third string. A dissonant card asks whether the neighbours might talk without him translating. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Verbindung besteht ausschließlich über den Vermittler.

variant_notes.note_en: Keeps three people apart by insisting he is the only thing joining them.

records.name: Amorette Vielzuviel
records.biography_en: Has already chosen matching curtains for a conversation that started seconds ago. Her HyperNorm arrow promises total belonging before a neighbour has finished saying hello. A dissonant card asks whether affection can leave room to breathe. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die gemeinsame Zukunft wurde vor dem Namen vereinbart.

variant_notes.note_en: Has already chosen matching curtains for a conversation that started seconds ago.

records.name: Torwart Nochweiter
records.biography_en: Agrees the target has been reached and proposes a more useful target. His HyperNorm goal moves whenever a dissonant card approaches it. He insists the old target was merely a useful preliminary misunderstanding. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Erfolg liegt jetzt in angemessenerer Entfernung.

variant_notes.note_en: Agrees the target has been reached and proposes a more useful target.

records.name: Kartenwart Bedauerlich
records.biography_en: Has a difficult story for every possible outcome and an extra card for sympathy. His HyperNorm cards offer a ready-made injury for every awkward question. A dissonant card carefully distinguishes real pain from the demand to stop asking. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Mitgefühl wird passend zur Gesprächslage ausgeteilt.

variant_notes.note_en: Has a difficult story for every possible outcome and an extra card for sympathy.

records.name: Rufmalerin Haftgrund
records.biography_en: Does not need the stain to be true if it is difficult to remove. Her HyperNorm roller leaves a stain that outlasts the allegation beneath it. A dissonant card asks why removing the mark is now the neighbour's job. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Anstrich haftet unabhängig vom Untergrund der Behauptung.

variant_notes.note_en: Does not need the stain to be true if it is difficult to remove.

records.name: Reaktionsbauer Ertragreich
records.biography_en: Harvests whatever grows fastest after a carefully planted insult. His HyperNorm basket rewards whichever reaction ripens fastest. A dissonant card suggests that a quiet, unharvestable neighbour may still be doing well. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Ertrag steigt mit der sorgfältig gesetzten Kränkung.

variant_notes.note_en: Harvests whatever grows fastest after a carefully planted insult.
